title: primula hirsuta subf. nivea
intro: Primula hirsuta subf. nivea, commonly known as the Alpine Cowslip or Snow Primrose, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the primrose family. This plant is known for its delicate white or pale yellow flowers and has been used in traditional medicine for centuries. The health benefits of Primula hirsuta subf. nivea include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help to soothe digestive issues and reduce oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions of promoting relaxation, reducing anxiety, and supporting immune function.
